data.one_liner: Check if device has a torch and turn it on or off.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that checks if the device has an available torch/flashlight, and provides methods to enable and disable it. It includes specific exception handling for scenarios like camera in use or torch not available.
use_when: You need to turn the device flashlight on or off programmatically.
You need to check if a torch is available on the current device.
avoid_when: You are building a full camera application that handles video capturing and custom camera controls.
strengths: Simple and straightforward API for torch management
Comprehensive error handling with specific exceptions
weaknesses: Limited to a single specific device feature (torch control)
data.setup_notes: Requires Android SDK 6.0 (API level 23) or higher. Built-in Kotlin and Swift Package Manager support.
